environment.runtime: Candle 0.11.0; CPU F32; no new inference dependency
environment.scope: Other agents are compiling during this evaluation; timings are observations under load, not isolated throughput claims.

implementation: Rust Candle CPU F32 inference; prototype Moonshine Streaming offline port, not verified tensor-for-tensor against Transformers.

verification.unit_tests: 31 passed, 4 existing asset-dependent tests ignored in the normal speech filter
verification.cargo_check: cargo check --locked -p lince-fiote --all-targets passed; no Rust warnings.
verification.fetch: Shared Rust fetch downloaded missing pinned config and tokenizer into a fresh cache and verified SHA-256; weights reused through a hard link.
verification.format: Targeted rustfmt --check and git diff --check passed.
verification.phonon_production_regression: Asset-dependent production Recognizer test passed with the natural JFK sample; second inference reused the loaded engine and cold_load_ms was zero.

limitations: Small mixed corpus: one public natural short recording, synthetic Kokoro speech, and digital silence. An additional public human JFK recording is evaluated separately. These are regression checks, not population accuracy or general model rankings.
Strict WER retains alternate spellings such as metres/meters, 10:00/ten, and spelled letters/CSV as differences. Raw transcripts and original references are retained.

Moonshine Small emitted You for digital silence on both repetitions; mandatory silence acceptance fails even though aggregate WER is within its configured threshold. No silence filter hides this result.
Moonshine is available to the evaluation API/CLI. Fiote speech model selection and incremental microphone streaming are not integrated for Moonshine.
New compatible Moonshine Streaming checkpoints use JSON configuration; other architectures need a Backend adapter and loader. Phonon uses its registered pinned checkpoint.
No provider/account/LLM, production binary, user microphone, or Fiote routing/action test was run.

comparison.normalization: Lowercase alphanumeric words, punctuation separators, split adjacent letters and digits; zero through ten and mister normalized. Raw hypotheses and references retained. Aggregate word edit distance divided by reference words; silence insertions counted.
comparison.scope: Sequential isolated model processes on the same fixture bytes and repeat order. Cache reuse is explicit; cold load includes integrity checks. This small corpus is a regression comparison, not a general accuracy benchmark or a Fiote wake/routing/account/UI test.
